evidence: src/memory/gateway.ts selectStore() exhaustive explicit branch; memoryContextFromSession derives domain from SessionRecord only; strict API schemas reject domain/database/namespace/context_key (tests/memory/api.test.ts, isolation.test.ts).

criterion: Cross-domain retrieval/list/delete/write tests pass, including known-ID attacks.
evidence: tests/memory/isolation.test.ts: sentinel isolation (PERSONAL_SENTINEL/BUSINESS_SENTINEL), known business id delete from personal session -> INVALID_REQUEST, client-supplied domain fields rejected, model-proposed memory_write tool rejected, business query for personal sentinel returns no personal data.

criterion: Local embeddings and persistent vector retrieval work behind replaceable interfaces.
evidence: EmbeddingGateway interface + EmbeddingGatewayImpl (batch 16, max 64 texts, 16k chars); local_multilingual (FNV-1a n-gram, 384d) and fake (64d) providers; vectors persisted as Float32Array BLOBs in memory_chunks; VectorSearch adapter. evidence: HybridRetriever: vector channel + FTS5 bm25 channel + RRF (k=60) + dedupe + reranker + token budget; SQL joins filter status='ACTIVE', expiry, domain, project/subject/type. Tests: tests/memory/retrieval.test.ts + tests/unit/memory_units.test.ts (fusion, reranker, FTS builder).

criterion: ContextBuilder sends only bounded, sanitized, same-domain memory snippets to DeepSeek, marked untrusted.
evidence: MemoryContextSource emits a single labeled user-role block (<memory domain=...>) with XML-escaped items; ModelRequest.memory metadata {domain, context_tokens, included}; budgets enforced (1200/300 defaults). Tests: isolation 'mode-safe context' captures the exact provider ModelRequest and asserts sentinel presence/absence per domain; prompt_injection asserts contracts/tools unchanged.

criterion: Explicit remember/search/list/forget works through API and CLI; document add/list works through API and CLI.
evidence: apps/api/server.ts routes POST /v1/memory/remember, POST /v1/memory/search, GET /v1/memory/status, GET /v1/memory, DELETE /v1/memory/{id}, POST /v1/documents, GET/DELETE /v1/documents/{id}; apps/cli/index.ts arthur memory remember|search|list|forget|status and arthur documents add|list. criterion: Text/Markdown document ingestion is idempotent, persistent, chunked, embedded, and sourced.
evidence: DocumentIngestionService: sanitize -> normalize -> hash -> reserve -> chunk (paragraph/sentence boundaries, overlap, hard split) -> embed -> writeDocumentAtomic (source + item + chunks + FTS in one transaction) -> complete. Deterministic doc-<hash32> ids + INSERT OR IGNORE convergence. Tests: tests/memory/ingestion.test.ts (idempotency, conflict, convergence, deletion, isolation, chunking).

criterion: Automatic memory extraction is schema-validated, policy-controlled, deduplicated, and secret-safe; malformed output cannot write memory.
evidence: MemoryExtractor + strict zod memoryExtractionSchema; parseExtractionOutput never throws; decideCandidate policy (confidence/importance thresholds, secret scan, length limits); TurnMemoryExtractor opt-in hook, failures swallowed. Tests: tests/memory/extraction.test.ts + secrets.test.ts (malformed JSON, schema violations, low-confidence/secret candidates, disabled-no-extra-call).

criterion: Supersession, expiry, deletion, and restart behavior are tested.
evidence: tests/memory/lifecycle.test.ts: restart persistence (file-backed), idempotent remember, key-conflict rejection, provenance update, user correction supersession (SUPERSEDED excluded from retrieval, auditable), forget tombstones + FTS/vector removal, TEMPORARY TTL expiry, type/size validation.

criterion: Prompt-injection memories cannot alter mode, system policy, tools, or approvals.
evidence: tests/memory/prompt_injection.test.ts: injected instructions in memory leave systemContract/modeContract/toolSchemas unchanged; injection text appears only inside the untrusted memory block; cross-domain query for business secret from personal session returns nothing; no memory tools exist.
